test_generic_400_heuristic: test the generic 400 error heuristic that treats large sessions as probable context overflow
test_agent_failed_early_detection: test that agent_failed_early flag is set when failed=True regardless of final_response
test_compression_exhausted_flag: test that compression_exhausted flag is set alongside failed=True when max compression attempts reached
test_context_overflow_error_detection: test that context-related error keywords are detected and flagged as context failures
test_persistence_skip_on_large_400: test that message persistence is skipped when status 400 occurs with a large session
